ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p161/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p161/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p161/r1.claim: Even after witnessing the miracle, Pharaoh denied Moses's message, calling him a magician and a liar.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p161/r1.anchor: and dubbed him as a magician and a liar

BIQAI-FULL:v8p308#s079/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p308#s079/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p308#s079/r1.claim: The surah’s purpose is to establish resurrection and the gathering, displaying humanity’s final fate after the preceding surahs’ full exposition; its oaths show the matter has reached its decisive climax.

ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r18.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r18.speaker: author
ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r18.claim: Despite witnessing the great sign, Pharaoh rejected it as magic and accused Moses of lying.
ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r18.anchor: Fakat Firavun tekzib etti söze inanmadığı gibi o büyük mucizeyi gördüğü hâlde de ona sihir dedi ve Mûsâ’ya yalan isnad etti

ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r19.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r19.speaker: author
ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r19.claim: Pharaoh rebelled against God and His command, spurning purification with the taunt “Who is the Lord of the worlds?”
ELMALILI:79:6-26#2/r19.anchor: temizlenmeye niyet etmek şöyle dursun وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ [eş-Şu‘arâ 26/23] “o Rabbü’l-âlemîn ne oluyormuş” diye karşılayarak inkâr ve isyâna cüret etti.

QASHANI:79:18-26/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:79:18-26/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:79:18-26/r3.claim: Pharaoh denied the sign and disobeyed Moses through his transgression and self-aggrandizement.
QASHANI:79:18-26/r3.anchor: فكذبه في أن وراء ما بلغ من المقام رتبة { وعصى } أمره لتفرعنه وعتوه

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p329/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p329/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p329/r1.claim: Pharaoh denied that the two signs came from God, disobeyed, turned away from faith, and worked to spread corruption.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p329/r1.anchor: فكذب} بأنهما من الله {وعصى} {ثم أدبر} تولى وأعرض عن الإيمان {يسعى} يعمل بالفساد في الأرض.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r4.claim: Seeing the sign led Pharaoh to deny what should have brought belief, then to arrogantly disobey after the proof was established.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r4.anchor: أنه أوقع التكذيب بشيء إنما يقتضي عند رؤيته التصديق

BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r5.claim: His disobedience was major refusal and arrogance, joined to denial despite the proof of the message's truth.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p315/r5.anchor: وهو الإباء الكبير والتكبر عن امتثال مادعي إليه مجموعا إلى التكذيب بعد إقامة الدليل على الصدق

JISHUMI:v10p7271/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7271/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7271/r10.claim: Jishumi argues that human acts originate from the servants themselves, citing Pharaoh's transgression, denial, turning away, and calling out.

MUQATIL:79:15-26/r10.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:79:15-26/r10.speaker: author
MUQATIL:79:15-26/r10.claim: Pharaoh denied the sign as being from God, called it magic, and disobeyed by refusing faith.
MUQATIL:79:15-26/r10.anchor: وزعم أنه ليس من الله عز وجل { وعصى } فقال: إنه سحر، { وعصى } أيضا يعني استعصى عن الإيمان،

NAHHAS:v5p143/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p143/r12.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p143/r12.claim: The fāʾ indicates that the second action follows the first, whereas wāw's basic function is conjunction or simultaneity.
NAHHAS:v5p143/r12.anchor: معنى الفاء أنها تدل على أن الثاني بعد الأول والواو للاجتماع هذا أصلها

STUDYQURAN:79:15/r11.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:79:15/r11.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:79:15/r11.claim: Despite the sorcerers recognizing Moses' superiority and the truth of his signs, Pharaoh kept denying them and dismissed the staff and white hand as sorcery.
STUDYQURAN:79:15/r11.anchor: Even after Pharaoh’s sorcerers acknowledged the superiority of Moses and the veracity of the signs with which he had been sent

TABRISI:79:15-24/r17.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:79:15-24/r17.speaker: author
TABRISI:79:15-24/r17.claim: Pharaoh denied that the sign came from God, disobeyed God's prophet, and rejected his prophethood.
TABRISI:79:15-24/r17.anchor: { فكذب } بأنها من الله { وعصى } نبي الله وجحد نبوته

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:79:20-25/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:79:20-25/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:79:20-25/r2.claim: Pharaoh rejected Moses and disobeyed him.

RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r1.claim: Pharaoh denied that the miracle proved Moses truthful; Rāzī lists possible attacks on miracles, then says the following action shows Pharaoh thought this one could be matched.
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r1.anchor: أن فرعون إنما منع من دلالته عن الصدق لاعتقاده أنه يمكن معارضته

RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r2.claim: Rāzī's taxonomy of objections includes possible imitation, a nondivine agent, no divine intent to authenticate, or no necessary entailment of the claimant's truth.
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r2.anchor: إما لاعتقاد أنه يمكن معارضته ، أو لأنه وإن امتنعت معارضته لكنه ليس فعلا لله

RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r3.claim: The two verbs distinguish denial in heart and speech from the outward display of defiance and tyranny.
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r3.anchor: كذب بالقلب واللسان ، وعصى بأن أظهر التمرد والتجبر

RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r4.claim: This denial and disobedience followed Moses' invitation and display of the miracle, making it different from Pharaoh's earlier rejection.
RAZI-FULL:v31p39/r4.anchor: تكذيبه لموسى عليها لسلام وقد دعاه وأظهر هذه المعجزة

TABATABAI:79:19-22/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:79:19-22/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:79:19-22/r7.claim: Pharaoh denied Moses and rejected his mission, calling him a sorcerer.
TABATABAI:79:19-22/r7.anchor: أي كذب موسى فجحد رسالته وسماه ساحرا

TABATABAI:79:19-22/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:79:19-22/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:79:19-22/r8.claim: The disobedience may be to Moses' instruction or to God.
TABATABAI:79:19-22/r8.anchor: وعصاه فيما أمره به أو عصى الله

BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r4.claim: Immediately after seeing the great sign, Pharaoh called it magic and denied Moses without further inspection, reflection, or consulting reason and conscience, out of arrogance and rebellion.
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r4.anchor: فرعون بموسى وسمى معجزته سحرا عقيب رأية الآية من غير رؤية وتأمل

BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r5.claim: He disobeyed God in extreme rebellion despite knowing the truth of the command, daring to deny the existence of the Lord of the worlds; the conjunction connects the sign’s effect to culpable denial.
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r5.anchor: الله بالتمرد بعد ما علم صحة الأمر ووجود الطاعة أشد عصيان وأقبحه

BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r6.claim: The denial is a verbal rejection despite inner certainty that the person denied deserved belief; denying someone not entitled to belief is not disobedience.
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r6.anchor: وهو التكذيب باللسان مع حصول الجزم بأن من كذبه ممن يجب تصديقه

BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r7.claim: Another possible reading is that Pharaoh disobeyed Moses in what Moses ordered; the author says the denial of God is more effective in condemning him.
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r7.anchor: ويجوز أن يراد وعصى موسى فيما أمر به إلا أن الأل أدخل في ذمه

BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r8.speaker: بعض أهل المعرفة
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r8.claim: Some spiritual knowers say that seeing signs rather than the lights of divine attributes left Pharaoh veiled from love and submission: witnessing attributes yields humility, while a vision of the essence produces insolence.
BURSEVI:v10p249#2/r8.anchor: قال بعض أهل المعرفة آاه آية صرفا ولو أراه أنوار الصفات في الآيات لم يكفر

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p398/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p398/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p398/r9.claim: Pharaoh denied Moses and his miracle by calling it magic, rebelling against God despite knowing its truth.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p398/r9.anchor: فكذب: أي فرعون موسى عليه السلام وما أتى به من المعجز، وجعل ذلك من باب السحر

ALUSI-FULL:v30p30/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30/r1.claim: Pharaoh denied Moses, called his miracle magic, and knowingly disobeyed God; his rebellion included daring to deny the Lord of the worlds, though he and his people were commanded to worship God and abandon his claimed divinity, not merely release Israel.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30/r1.anchor: وسمى معجزته سحرا وعصى الله تعالى بالتمرد بعد ما علم صحة الأمر ووجوب الطاعة

ALUSI-FULL:v30p30/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30/r2.claim: Making Moses the object of denial and God the object of disobedience is more condemnatory than making Moses the object of both verbs.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p30/r2.anchor: وفي جعل متعلق التكذيب موسى عليه السلام ومتعلق العصيان الله عز وجل ما ليس في جعلهما موسى كما قيل فكذب موسى وعصاه من الذم

BAYDAWI-FULL:79:17-22/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:79:17-22/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:79:17-22/r8.claim: After the sign appeared and the matter was established, Pharaoh denied Moses and disobeyed God.
BAYDAWI-FULL:79:17-22/r8.anchor: فكذب موسى وعصى الله عز وجل بعد ظهور الآية وتحقق الأمر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p78/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p78/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p78/r5.claim: The quick sequence after seeing the sign highlights Pharaoh's stubbornness: he did not pause to consider its proof before rushing to denial and disobedience.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p78/r5.anchor: وأعقب فعل { فأراه الآية الكبرى } بفعل { فكذب } للدلالة على شدة عناده ومكابرته

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p78/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p78/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p78/r6.claim: His disobedience may mean rejecting God's command to worship Him alone or refusing to release the Israelites from enslavement and forced service.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p78/r6.anchor: والمراد بعصيانه عصيان أمر الله أن يوحده أو أن يطلق بني إسرائيل من استعبادهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p21/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p21/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p21/r1.claim: Pharaoh denied that the message was from God and disobeyed His messenger.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p21/r1.anchor: فكذب أي بأنها من الله وعصى نبيه

NASAFI-FULL:v4p314#12/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p314#12/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p314#12/r1.claim: Pharaoh denied Moses and the great sign, called Moses a sorcerer and the sign sorcery, and disobeyed God.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p314#12/r1.anchor: فرعون بموسى والآية الكبرى وسماها ساحرا وسحرا
